notes: Outreach for Slack notifications (sales engagement). Mirrors Outreach's real card shape: NO header block — a bold statement line, then a blockquote (gray left-bar via mrkdwn `>`) of detail lines prefixed with emoji, then an `actions` row of buttons. Two families: meeting updates (prospect booked/rescheduled a meeting → 'View prospect in Outreach') and Kaia recording mentions/comments (someone @mentioned you → 'Reply' + 'View comment in Outreach'). The 'View … in Outreach' buttons are URL buttons (open Outreach, no app response needed); 'Reply' is a plain action button (visual only — unhandled clicks show a transient warning to the clicker). Fits sales/AE/pipeline channels. Logo: add logos/outreach.png (indigo rounded-square pin) + push_logos.py, or pass --icon-emoji :round_pushpin: until then.

examples.name: meeting_booked
examples.when: A prospect books a meeting with the rep — meeting-updates notification to a sales/AE DM or channel.
